summary: Derived key-file watches trigger reindex but unchanged graph metadata prevents candidate projection updates.
Normal root selection consumes SKILL and graph projection fields, not hub registry/router or leaf JSON.
High-specificity hub vocabulary is invisible until parent selection, producing confirmed natural-language activation misses.
Filesystem fallback retains direct root fields but drops graph edges and doc-trigger projections.
Executor delegation directly consumes hub aliases but memoizes them without source-change invalidation.
Compiled sk-doc routing is active and conservative, while committed evaluation supports only moderate version-sensitive root accuracy.
